# DNS Parking
> DNS Parking provides domain parking, DNS management, and related domain monetization and forwarding services.

The site focuses on helping domain owners park unused domains, manage DNS records, configure forwarding, and monetize traffic through parking-related tools and account services.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://dns-parking.com/): Overview of DNS Parking services, domain parking, and account access.
- [Login](https://dns-parking.com/login): User login for managing parked domains and DNS settings.
- [Register](https://dns-parking.com/register): Account registration for new users of the DNS Parking platform.
- [Contact](https://dns-parking.com/contact): Contact page for support and business inquiries.
- [About](https://dns-parking.com/about): Background information about the company and its services.

## Domain Parking
- [Domain Parking](https://dns-parking.com/domain-parking): Information about parking domains and monetizing undeveloped traffic.
- [Add Domain](https://dns-parking.com/add-domain): Start the process of adding a domain to the parking platform.
- [Parked Domains](https://dns-parking.com/parked-domains): Manage and review domains currently parked in the account.
- [Parking Statistics](https://dns-parking.com/statistics): View traffic and revenue statistics for parked domains.
- [Revenue Reports](https://dns-parking.com/reports): Access reporting for earnings and domain performance.

## DNS Management
- [DNS Management](https://dns-parking.com/dns-management): Overview of DNS record management and configuration tools.
- [Nameservers](https://dns-parking.com/nameservers): Configure or review nameserver settings for managed domains.
- [DNS Records](https://dns-parking.com/dns-records): Manage A, CNAME, MX, TXT, and other DNS records.
- [Zone Editor](https://dns-parking.com/zone-editor): Edit DNS zones for domains hosted on the platform.
- [Bulk DNS](https://dns-parking.com/bulk-dns): Apply DNS changes across multiple domains efficiently.

## Forwarding and Redirects
- [URL Forwarding](https://dns-parking.com/url-forwarding): Set up redirects from parked domains to destination URLs.
- [Email Forwarding](https://dns-parking.com/email-forwarding): Configure email forwarding for domains on the platform.
- [Domain Redirects](https://dns-parking.com/domain-redirects): Manage redirect behavior for individual domains.
- [Masked Forwarding](https://dns-parking.com/masked-forwarding): Configure masked forwarding options where supported.

## Account and Billing
- [Dashboard](https://dns-parking.com/dashboard): Central account dashboard for domains, DNS, and reporting.
- [Profile](https://dns-parking.com/profile): Manage account profile details and preferences.
- [Billing](https://dns-parking.com/billing): Review billing details, payments, and account charges.
- [Payout Settings](https://dns-parking.com/payout-settings): Configure payout preferences for parking revenue.
- [Invoices](https://dns-parking.com/invoices): Access invoice history and billing documents.

## Help and Support
- [Help Center](https://dns-parking.com/help): Support resources for common platform and DNS questions.
- [FAQ](https://dns-parking.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about parking, DNS, and accounts.
- [Support](https://dns-parking.com/support): Support contact and assistance options for customers.
- [Knowledge Base](https://dns-parking.com/knowledge-base): Articles covering setup, troubleshooting, and platform usage.
- [Terms of Service](https://dns-parking.com/terms): Terms governing use of the DNS Parking service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dns-parking.com/privacy): Privacy practices and data handling information.

## Developer and Integration
- [API](https://dns-parking.com/api): Programmatic access for managing domains and DNS operations.
- [API Documentation](https://dns-parking.com/api/docs): Reference documentation for authentication and endpoints.
- [API Keys](https://dns-parking.com/api-keys): Manage API credentials for account integrations.
- [Webhooks](https://dns-parking.com/webhooks): Configure event notifications for domain and account activity.

## Company and Updates
- [Blog](https://dns-parking.com/blog): Articles and updates related to domains, DNS, and monetization.
- [News](https://dns-parking.com/news): Company announcements and service updates.
- [Status](https://dns-parking.com/status): Service availability and operational status information.
- [Partners](https://dns-parking.com/partners): Information for affiliates, partners, or integration relationships.
